tiktok.caption: Tapping your phone to pay? MIT found you spend 83% more than with cash — here's why

youtube_short.title: Why Tap-to-Pay Makes You Spend 83% More
title_alternatives: The Dark Side of Contactless Payments Nobody Talks About
MIT Proved Cashless Payments Are Wrecking Your Budget
youtube_short.description:
Every time you tap your card or phone, your brain barely registers the money leaving — and researchers call this the 'pain of paying.' MIT found people consistently spend 83% more with cashless payments versus physical cash. That convenience is costing the average person $2,400 a year. Try using cash for just one spending category — food, coffee, or shopping — and watch what happens. #moneypsychology #personalfinance #savemoney #cashlesssociety

Follow for daily finance psychology videos.

hook_line: You spend 83% MORE when you tap to pay
